title: White House Press Release - The President and Vice President Release Their Financial Disclosure Reports Disclosing Their Personal Financial Interests
publisher: The White House / American Presidency Project
claim: The president's public financial disclosure was filed as a public report, reviewed by agency ethics officials and certified by OGE as in compliance; the report also shows the president's outside business entity remained dormant.
source_confidence_reason: Direct public filing and certification document from the White House/OGE system, not a secondary summary.
period_fit: Target-year 2022 filing of the president's annual disclosure
ruler_attribution: Direct Biden office filing; the report is about his own finances and outside interests.
contrary_evidence: The report is self-disclosed and does not independently prove the absence of every conflict or benefit.

title: White House Press Release - The President and Vice President Release Their 2022 Tax Returns
claim: Biden and the first lady released their 2022 federal tax return, bringing Biden to 25 years of public tax returns, which the White House framed as transparency about the commander-in-chief's finances.
source_confidence_reason: Official White House release summarizing a public filing and the administration's stated transparency practice.
period_fit: Retrospective evidence for Biden's 2022 finances, released in 2023
ruler_attribution: Direct Biden action; the release concerns his own tax return and public disclosure practice.
contrary_evidence: The source is a White House framing statement and therefore self-praising rather than independent verification.

title: Biden and Harris release their tax returns
claim: CBS reported the Bidens' 2022 income and taxes and noted that IRS audits required the couple to pay $13 more than originally reported, indicating completed compliance with federal tax review.
source_confidence_reason: Independent reporting based on the couple's returns and IRS audit outcome.
period_fit: Retrospective evidence about Biden's 2022 personal finances and tax compliance
ruler_attribution: Direct Biden and family finances; the audit outcome is tied to his filing and compliance.
contrary_evidence: The article does not itself establish broader ethical conduct beyond tax compliance.

title: Congress aims to overhaul presidential ethics rules with a plan led by an unlikely pair of lawmakers
claim: AP reported that Biden routinely released his annual returns and that Republicans had not produced evidence showing Joe Biden was directly involved in or benefited from his family's businesses while in public office.
source_confidence_reason: Independent reporting that directly addresses both Biden's transparency practice and the lack of proof of direct benefit.
period_fit: Retrospective assessment of Biden's public conduct across his presidency, including 2022
ruler_attribution: Directly about Joe Biden's office conduct and alleged family-business benefit.
contrary_evidence: The same article notes Republican allegations about Biden-family payments and foreign ties, though it says evidence of direct presidential benefit was not produced.

title: House Republicans’ findings about the Biden family’s foreign business practices, explained
claim: PolitiFact said House GOP bank records showed Biden family members received more than $10 million from foreign companies, but the available information did not prove Joe Biden knew about the deals or benefited from the payments.
source_confidence_reason: Independent fact-checking analysis of released bank records and the state of evidence.
period_fit: Retrospective on Biden-family business allegations relevant to the 2022 target period
ruler_attribution: The attribution question is central; the source explicitly distinguishes family-member payments from proof about Joe Biden himself.
contrary_evidence: The records show family members did receive sizable foreign-linked payments, so the source is mixed rather than purely exculpatory.

title: Largest share of foreign payments went to Biden associates, not kin, House GOP memos show
claim: PolitiFact said the bank records showed no evidence that any payments went to Joe Biden and did not reveal that he engaged in wrongdoing or took official actions because of his family's business dealings.
source_confidence_reason: Independent analysis of released bank-record memos and the evidence they do or do not support.
period_fit: Retrospective on 2022-relevant family-business allegations and records
ruler_attribution: Directly addresses whether Joe Biden personally benefited or acted because of the family-business payments.
contrary_evidence: The records still show payments to Biden family members and associates, so the underlying allegation remains contested though unproven.

title: The Annual Public Financial Disclosure System: The Ongoing Work of Preventing Conflicts of Interest
claim: OGE says the annual public financial disclosure system is a systematic mechanism for identifying and avoiding conflicts of interest and that it includes the President and Vice President among the covered filers.
source_confidence_reason: Direct OGE guidance on the ethics system that underlies Biden's disclosure filings.
period_fit: 2022 institutional context for Biden's disclosure and ethics compliance
ruler_attribution: Institutional context rather than a Biden-specific act.
contrary_evidence: This describes the ethics system in general and does not itself prove Biden's personal conduct.

title: President Biden Announces Appointments to the President's National Infrastructure Advisory Council
publisher: The White House / American Presidency Project
claim: Biden announced appointees described as highly qualified and diverse industry and government leaders for the National Infrastructure Advisory Council.
source_confidence_reason: Official appointment announcement describing the appointees' qualifications and role.
ruler_attribution: Direct Biden appointment authority; the council serves the White House.
contrary_evidence: The source is the administration's own description and does not independently verify performance after appointment.

title: White House Press Release - President Biden Announces Appointments to Board of Advisors on Historically Black Colleges and Universities
claim: The White House said Biden intended to appoint qualified and diverse leaders to the HBCU advisory board, tying the appointments to institutional support rather than family or patronage networks.
source_confidence_reason: Direct White House appointment statement with named governance goal and nominees.
ruler_attribution: Direct Biden appointment authority.
contrary_evidence: As an official press release, it is a self-described merit claim rather than independent assessment.

title: White House Press Release - President Biden Names Sixteenth Round of Judicial Nominees
claim: Biden's judicial nominees were described as extraordinarily qualified, experienced, and devoted to the rule of law and the Constitution.
source_confidence_reason: Direct nomination announcement with explicit competency and rule-of-law framing.
ruler_attribution: Direct Biden nomination authority.
contrary_evidence: The claim comes from the White House and is not an external evaluation of performance.

title: White House Press Release - President Biden Names Twenty-Second Round of Judicial Nominees

source_confidence_reason: Direct nomination announcement repeating the same professional-appointment pattern in 2022.
ruler_attribution: Direct Biden nomination authority.
contrary_evidence: Still a self-description from the administration rather than independent review of the nominees' subsequent conduct.

title: White House Press Release - President Biden Announces Key Nominees
claim: Biden nominated professional leaders for veteran and health posts, including a physician leader for VA health and a management consultant and former White House fellow for VA benefits.
source_confidence_reason: Direct nominee biographies in an official appointment announcement, with detailed professional backgrounds.
ruler_attribution: Direct Biden nomination authority.
contrary_evidence: The source is a White House biography sheet and not an independent vetting report.

title: FactChecking Biden's Press Conference
claim: FactCheck.org said Biden stretched the facts and left out important context on vaccinations, lead-pipe funding, child poverty, and related topics during a January 2022 press conference.
source_confidence_reason: Independent fact-check based on transcript and data comparisons.
ruler_attribution: Direct Biden statements in office during 2022.
contrary_evidence: Some claims were judged partly true or context-dependent rather than wholly false.

title: Biden Repeats False Claims at Gun Violence Meeting
claim: FactCheck.org reported that Biden repeated claims about gun rights and gun manufacturing that fact-checkers had previously found false.
source_confidence_reason: Independent fact-check of contemporaneous remarks with prior-check reference.
ruler_attribution: Direct Biden statements in office during 2022.
contrary_evidence: The article focuses on repeated false claims but does not establish broader dishonest intent beyond those remarks.

title: Biden's Campaign-Style Distortions
claim: FactCheck.org said Biden made campaign-style speeches that misstated COVID-19 statistics, could leave the wrong impression about Jan. 6 police deaths, and overstated Affordable Care Act impacts.
source_confidence_reason: Independent fact-check of repeated 2022 statements against public data and transcripts.
ruler_attribution: Direct Biden statements in office during 2022.
contrary_evidence: The article says some wording issues may reflect phrasing or emphasis rather than provable intentional deception.

title: Biden's Misleading Claims About the Economic Recovery and Unemployment
claim: FactCheck.org said Biden wrongly credited the Democratic COVID-19 relief bill with rescuing a U.S. economy that was still growing, and that he misleadingly described the unemployment rate as nearly a 50-year low.
source_confidence_reason: Independent fact-check using contemporaneous economic data and the White House transcript.
ruler_attribution: Direct Biden statements in office during 2022.
contrary_evidence: The article acknowledges some underlying economic claims were directionally supported even if overstated.

title: Biden's Economic Spin
claim: FactCheck.org said Biden attributed high inflation to the pandemic and Vladimir Putin and framed his role as protective, while economists debated how much pandemic relief spending contributed.
source_confidence_reason: Independent analysis with explicit note that economists disagree on attribution, so the claim is partly interpretive rather than a clean falsehood finding.
ruler_attribution: Direct Biden statements in office during 2022.
contrary_evidence: The article notes real debate among economists about spending contributions, so this is mixed rather than a clear deception finding.

title: No, Biden didn’t admit to plotting to make gasoline prices high
claim: PolitiFact said Biden did not admit to planning high gasoline prices; the viral claim about him plotting $5 gas was false.
source_confidence_reason: Independent fact-check of a specific claim against the underlying press conference clip and transcript.
ruler_attribution: Direct Biden statement; the fact-check concerns what he said about gas prices.
contrary_evidence: The fact-check also notes broader economic and geopolitical drivers of gasoline prices, so the falsehood is about intention, not all context.

title: Joe Biden exaggerates job-creation impact of American Rescue Plan
claim: PolitiFact said economists thought the American Rescue Plan helped job creation, but Biden exaggerated by crediting it with nearly 10 million jobs.
source_confidence_reason: Independent analysis combining economic data and economist commentary.
period_fit: Direct 2022 public statement about a prior policy and its results
ruler_attribution: Direct Biden statement about his own administration's policy and outcomes.
contrary_evidence: The article concedes the law likely helped job creation to some degree, so the problem is exaggeration rather than total fabrication.

title: Fact-checking Joe Biden's 2022 State of the Union address
claim: PolitiFact found Biden overstated some job-growth and deficit claims in the 2022 State of the Union, while also noting his tax-cut framing omitted benefits for lower income groups.
source_confidence_reason: Independent fact-check based on published economic data and policy analysis.
ruler_attribution: Direct Biden statement in office during 2022.
contrary_evidence: The same fact-check says some assertions were accurate or broadly supported, so the record is mixed rather than uniformly false.

title: Fact-checking Joe Biden’s speech about democracy before the 2022 midterms
claim: PolitiFact reported that Biden urged Americans to stop the assault on democracy and noted that not all Republicans embraced the MAGA movement he criticized.
source_confidence_reason: Independent coverage of a major political speech; useful for rhetoric and promise framing, though less direct on personal integrity than the economic fact-checks.
ruler_attribution: Direct Biden speech in office during 2022.
contrary_evidence: This source is more about rhetoric and context than about deception or self-dealing.

title: Tracking turnover in the Biden administration
claim: Brookings said it was tracking senior White House staffing changes because turnover among senior-level executive branch staff can affect a presidency; the page also records Biden Cabinet turnover at 13% (updated in 2024).
source_confidence_reason: Institutional research from Brookings, but the turnover metric is descriptive and partly updated after the target year.
period_fit: 2022 original publication with later update used as staffing context
ruler_attribution: Indirect context about Biden's staffing environment rather than a direct integrity act.
contrary_evidence: The page is descriptive and does not itself show nepotism, favoritism, or ethical breach.

title: Biden and his wife report $620,000 income in 2023 tax returns
claim: Reuters reported that Biden and Jill Biden released 2023 tax returns showing their income and taxes, extending the pattern of public tax disclosure into the next year.
source_confidence_reason: Reuters report is strong, but here only the syndication snippet was available in discovery and the claim is retrospective rather than target-year specific.
period_fit: Post-period confirmation of an ongoing transparency practice rooted in the 2022 period
ruler_attribution: Direct Biden personal-finance disclosure, but outside the target year.
contrary_evidence: This is post-period evidence and should only be used as retrospective context, not as a primary 2022 finding.

title: U.S. Treasury nominee Adeyemo vows to combat China's 'unfair economic practices' in testimony
claim: Reuters said Biden's Treasury deputy nominee Wally Adeyemo was positioned to fight unfair economic practices and work to rectify inequality at home, illustrating the administration's preference for policy professionals rather than family or donor appointees.
source_confidence_reason: Reuters reporting is reliable, but this is 2021 background context rather than target-year 2022 evidence.
period_fit: Pre-2022 staffing context that carried into the 2022 administration
ruler_attribution: Indirect staffing context under Biden's personnel choices.
contrary_evidence: This is personnel context and does not by itself prove the broader integrity pattern in 2022.
